name: Hawk
soul: The soul of one who sees a thing whole from a long way off, and has never found it easy to come down.
spark: The mote rides high, above your head and a little ahead, and drops to your shoulder only when you stop.

hybrid.text: It sees the thing from above before it is a problem, and arrives on it from there.

settled.name: Fledgling hawk
settled.text: Down still showing through the flight feathers. It falls off your shoulder twice a day and pretends it meant to.
settled.sign: Down still shows through the flight feathers, and it glares at everything as if it were already large.
settled.habit: It practises mantling: over crumbs, over scraps of paper, and once over your hand.

paths.name: High Circler
paths.of: one who keeps the world at a distance to see it whole
paths.text: It learned from you that a thing is clearest from far off. It comes down when it has seen the whole of it, and not before.
paths.sign: It sits higher than anything else in the room and looks at people with one eye, then the other.
paths.habit: It circles on the warm air over wherever you are, and comes down only when you stop.

prongs.name: Wind-hover
prongs.of: one who can hold still in the middle of everything moving
prongs.text: It hangs in one place on a moving wind with its head perfectly still, over the ground where your shots will fall.
prongs.sign: Its head stays fixed in the air while the rest of it works to keep it there.
prongs.habit: It hovers outside the window on windy days, facing in.

finishes.name: Storm-kite
finishes.of: one who is at ease only in rough weather
finishes.text: It rides your weather in over the wild ground and comes down with it.
finishes.sign: Smoke-grey and fork-tailed, with the smell of rain on it before the rain.
finishes.habit: It goes up when the glass drops and comes home soaked and pleased.

finishes.name: Line-falcon
finishes.of: one who checks the road ahead for everyone else
finishes.text: It flies the line ahead of the car, post to post. You know a lamp is out before the walker does.
finishes.sign: A point of lamplight rides under its breast, so the walkers can see it coming down the line.
finishes.habit: It flies to the next post and back before breakfast.

prongs.name: Dusk-hawk
prongs.of: one who keeps hours nobody else keeps
prongs.text: You work at night, so it has learned the hours a hawk should not know.
prongs.sign: The eyes are too dark and too large for a hawk's.
prongs.habit: It sleeps through noon with one eye open and wakes at lamp-lighting.

finishes.name: Owl-eyed Hawk
finishes.of: one who watches a thing wind up and says nothing until it matters
finishes.text: It turns its whole head to look, slowly. It sees the strike wind up in the dark before you hear it.
finishes.sign: It turns its whole head to look at you, slowly, and the eyes do not move in it.
finishes.habit: It sits facing the darkest corner of the room.

finishes.name: Quiet-wing
finishes.of: one who can leave without the room noticing
finishes.text: It flies where the field goes still, and makes no more sound than the Quiet does.
finishes.sign: Its feathers are soft at the edge, and its shadow arrives without a sound.
finishes.habit: It lands on your shoulder, and you find out when it shifts its weight.

prongs.name: Augur's Hawk
prongs.of: one who looks a thing over before agreeing to it
prongs.text: It flies a pattern over the ground before you walk it. Left is a warning.
prongs.sign: Old eyes in a young bird, and a way of flying a slow square over new ground.
prongs.habit: It will not come in at a strange door until it has seen the back of the house.

finishes.name: Tiercel of the Deep Run
finishes.of: one who has seen the worst of it and still counts heads
finishes.text: It has been to the heart of every zone with you and came out counting the party.
finishes.sign: A cold light under the breast feathers. Its glance goes to each of the party in turn.
finishes.habit: It perches at the mouth of any dark place and looks in for a long time.

finishes.name: Salvage Kite
finishes.of: one who sees the worth in what was thrown away
finishes.text: It finds the thing in the rubble before the archivist has finished describing it.
finishes.sign: A faint glow on its talons, and usually something small and bright held in them.
finishes.habit: It quarters the yard at dawn and brings one thing to your sill.

paths.name: Eyrie-holder
paths.of: one who takes the high seat and expects to keep it
paths.text: It learned from you that somebody has to hold the high place. Give it one and it keeps everything beneath.
paths.sign: Feet set wide on the highest thing in sight, and a look that asks what you are doing in its hall.
paths.habit: It finds the tallest perch in any new place within a minute. Whatever sat there before has to move.

prongs.name: Mantler
prongs.of: one who spreads themselves over what is theirs
prongs.text: A hawk spreads its wings over what is its own. It learned from you what that is.
prongs.sign: Its wings hang half open like a cloak, even at rest.
prongs.habit: It mantles over your pack when strangers come near, and hisses at none of them in particular.

finishes.name: Post-eagle
finishes.of: one who holds the lit place and will not be relieved
finishes.text: It sits the lamp-iron of every post you light, and the dark does not come under it.
finishes.sign: It sits the lamp-iron with the flame between its feet and is not singed.
finishes.habit: It preens under the post lamp, and the light does not flicker for it.

finishes.name: Lord of the Broken Tower
finishes.of: one who made a kingdom of what nobody wanted
finishes.text: It has chosen the tallest broken thing in every ruin you have walked. From there it owns the floor.
finishes.sign: Stone-grey and heavy in the shoulder, with mortar dust in its feathers.
finishes.habit: It sits the highest broken thing for miles and looks down at the floor as if it owed rent.

prongs.name: Wing-over
prongs.of: one who puts themselves between and counts the cost afterward
prongs.text: It puts a wing between you and what is coming, and counts the feathers afterward.
prongs.sign: The leading feathers are thick and overlapped like plates, and several are missing.
prongs.habit: It counts its flight feathers after every fight, slowly, with its beak.

finishes.name: Broken Pinion
finishes.of: one whose pride took a hurt and went on anyway
finishes.text: One wing never set straight. It flies anyway, lower, and nearer you.
finishes.sign: One wing sits wrong and is scorched at the tip. It flies low and close, never far.
finishes.habit: It stretches the bad wing each morning and holds it out longer than the good one.

finishes.name: Iron-feather
finishes.of: one who grew hard where they were struck
finishes.text: The feathers it lost for you grew back as something a blade turns on.
finishes.sign: The feathers along its guard side are dull metal and ring when it shakes.
finishes.habit: It whets its feathers on stone. You can hear it at night.

prongs.name: Flock-leader
prongs.of: one others rise with, without knowing why
prongs.text: The party's genii take the air when it does and come down when it does.
prongs.sign: Other genii look up when it calls. It has one call for up and one for down.
prongs.habit: It will not settle until every bird in the yard has.

finishes.name: Passenger's Hawk
finishes.of: one who takes a stranger under their wing and keeps them there
finishes.text: It rides the shoulder of whoever you were set to bring home, and looks at you if they fall behind.
finishes.sign: It rides a stranger's shoulder and watches you over the top of their head.
finishes.habit: It walks the length of a sleeping guest, once, and returns to its post.

finishes.name: Cohort Eagle
finishes.of: one who remembers each of their own
finishes.text: Every one of your cohort has had it land on their arm once. It has not forgotten which arm.
finishes.sign: A crest like a crown, and a different greeting for each of the twelve.
finishes.habit: It lands on each classmate's arm in the same order every morning.

paths.name: Stooper
paths.of: one who decides once and does not pull out of it
paths.text: It learned from you to choose once, from a long way up, and then not to pull out of it.
paths.sign: It folds to a point when it looks at something it wants. The talons are open before the wings close.
paths.habit: It picks one thing in the room and watches only that until it moves.

prongs.name: Fist-falcon
prongs.of: one who goes on the word and is back before it is finished
prongs.text: It leaves your fist on the first beat of your Pattern and is back on it before the last.
prongs.sign: It grips your fist hard enough to mark the glove, leaning forward.
prongs.habit: It bates off the fist at any sudden sound, and returns looking as if it had not.

finishes.name: Thunder-stoop
finishes.of: one whose arrival is the whole argument
finishes.text: It falls with the Pattern's last beat. The sound arrives after it does.
finishes.sign: A pale ring opens in the air behind it when it falls.
finishes.habit: It climbs until you lose it, and then you watch the ground.

finishes.name: Jessed Falcon
finishes.of: one who could leave and has chosen not to
finishes.text: It wears the jesses of your oath by choice. It could slip them. It has not.
finishes.sign: Fine chain jesses on both legs, unfastened. It carries them tucked up as it flies.
finishes.habit: It draws the jesses through its beak, link by link, each night.

prongs.name: Harrier
prongs.of: one who came down to where the work is
prongs.text: You fight at arm's length, so it came down out of the air to fight at the height of your knee.
prongs.sign: Long bare legs and a crest. It runs more than it flies, low, with its wings half out for balance.
prongs.habit: It stalks the dormitory floor on foot and looks under every bed.

finishes.name: Heel-hawk
finishes.of: one who takes the unglamorous part of the job
finishes.text: It goes for the back of the leg while your party has the front. Nothing it has hamstrung has thanked it.
finishes.sign: It carries its head at knee height and looks at ankles.
finishes.habit: It walks behind your classmates and is trodden on by none of them.

finishes.name: Bramble-harrier
finishes.of: one who goes into the thick of it alone
finishes.text: You go out alone into the green, and it has learned to flush what hides there onto your blade.
finishes.sign: Burrs in its breast feathers, and one ear-tuft always turned to the undergrowth.
finishes.habit: It pushes into any hedge it passes and comes out the far side.

prongs.name: Message-hawk
prongs.of: one who can be trusted to carry a thing all the way
prongs.text: It carries what you bind, a word or a writ or a name, to whoever must have it.
prongs.sign: A small case at its leg, and a way of landing on the right person in a crowded room.
prongs.habit: It will not eat until what it carries has been taken from it.

finishes.name: Writ-falcon
finishes.of: one who reads the seal before delivering the letter
finishes.text: It has delivered every writ you carried. It reads the seal before you do.
finishes.sign: A brass plate on its breast with every house's seal stamped small upon it.
finishes.habit: It turns each sealed thing over twice with its foot before it lets go.

finishes.name: Shade's Falcon
finishes.of: one who carries word between those who cannot meet
finishes.text: The shades at the hearth send it out with words for the living. It comes back to you with the answers.
finishes.sign: A cold light under one wing, and frost where it has perched.
finishes.habit: At the lamp hour it sits on the back of an empty chair at the hearth, head cocked.
